text:
maria: Thinking about fallback orchestration for onprem upgrades — we still default to operator-local rollbacks if the central conductor isn't reachable. That has UX implications for support and observability.

alex: Agreed. Operator-local fallbacks are safer network-wise, but we lose global visibility. Support can't tell cluster state without additional telemetry.

ryan: Could we emit a compact activation event to our audit sink over a store-and-forward gateway? That keeps airgap safe but informs console when it syncs.

jen: Store-and-forward is fine but ops can't wait. We need clear indicators in the operator status: 'fallback_applied', 'pending_central_ack'. Short flags, easily greppable.

sophia: +1. Also consider a grace window config. If central reacquires within X minutes, automatic reconcile; otherwise keep local decision. Default X=15m?

maria: 15m feels long for some customers — make it configurable per cluster; sensitive regulators might want 0 (no auto-reconcile).

ops_bob: From support perspective, add a human-readable reason field. e.g., `fallback_reason: central-unreachable`. Saves us triage time.

alex: For safety, add a deterministic id to every fallback action so rollbacks/reconciles are idempotent: `fallback_id = sha256(manifest+timestamp)`.

deploy-bot: deploy: canary rollout started for onprem-upgrade v1.3.2 -> 3 nodes. status: canary-in-progress :hourglass_flowing_sand:

ryan: If canary fails and operator falls back locally, we should surface a one-click console action: 'force-sync from central' that replays manifest with validation.

jen: UX note: don't auto-expose 'force-sync' in read-only roles. Only support/admin. Documented in runbook.

maria: Action items: 1) propose status flags and reason enum 2) add fallback_id scheme 3) store-and-forward event sketch 4) runbook snippet for force-sync. I'll draft an RFC patch.

sophia: Thanks. small config snippet for RFC draft:
```
fallback:
  grace_window: 15m  # cluster override allowed
  allow_auto_reconcile: true
  audit_sink: storeforward://gateway.local:8080
```

maria: perfect. I'll post RFC PR later today. :thumbsup:
